heading: Specifications regarding the various components of the LPG equipment
title: General design rules regarding components
text: General design rules regarding components

heading: Specifications regarding the various components of the LPG equipment > General design rules regarding components
title: Provisions regarding the 80 per cent stop valve
text: Provisions regarding the 80 per cent stop valve

heading: Specifications regarding the various components of the LPG equipment > General design rules regarding components > Provisions regarding the 80 per cent stop valve
text: The connection between the float and the closing unit of the 80 per cent stop valve shall not be deformed under normal conditions of use.

heading: Specifications regarding the various components of the LPG equipment > General design rules regarding components > Provisions regarding the 80 per cent stop valve
text: If the 80 per cent stop valve of the container comprises a float, the latter shall withstand an outside pressure of 4,500 kPa.

heading: Specifications regarding the various components of the LPG equipment > General design rules regarding components > Provisions regarding the 80 per cent stop valve
text: The closing unit of the device that limits the filling at 80 per cent +0/-5 per cent of the capacity of the container, for which the 80 per cent stop valve is designed, shall withstand a pressure of 6,750 kPa. At the cut-off position, the filling rate at a differential pressure of 700 kPa shall not exceed 500 cm3 /minute. The valve shall be tested with all the containers on which it is intended to be fitted or the manufacturer shall declare by calculation for which container types this valve is suitable.

heading: Specifications regarding the various components of the LPG equipment > General design rules regarding components > Provisions regarding the 80 per cent stop valve
text: When the 80 per cent stop valve does not comprise any float, it shall not be possible to continue filling, after closing-off, at a rate exceeding 500 cm3 /minute.

heading: Specifications regarding the various components of the LPG equipment > General design rules regarding components > Provisions regarding the 80 per cent stop valve
text: The device shall bear a permanent marking, indicating the container-type for which it has been designed, diameter and angle, and if applicable mounting indication.

heading: Specifications regarding the various components of the LPG equipment > General design rules regarding components
text: Electrical operated devices containing LPG shall, in order to prevent in case of fracture of the component electric sparks on the surface of fracture: (a) Be insulated in a manner that no current is lead through LPG containing parts; (b) Have the electrical system of the device isolated: (i) From the body; (ii) From the container for the fuel pump. Isolation resistance shall be > 10 MΩ

heading: Specifications regarding the various components of the LPG equipment > General design rules regarding components > Provisions regarding the 80 per cent stop valve
text: The electrical connections inside the boot and passengers compartment shall comply with at least the minimum protection degree class IP 40 according to IEC Standard 60529-1989+A1:1999+A2:2013 or IP40 according to ISO20653:2013.

heading: Specifications regarding the various components of the LPG equipment > General design rules regarding components > Provisions regarding the 80 per cent stop valve
text: All other electrical connections shall comply with at least the minimum protection degree class IP 54 according to IEC Standard

heading: Specifications regarding the various components of the LPG equipment > General design rules regarding components > Provisions regarding the 80 per cent stop valve
text: The power supply bushing (fuel pump/actuators/fuel level sensor) to establish an isolated and tight electrical connection shall be of a hermetic sealed type.

heading: Specifications regarding the various components of the LPG equipment > General design rules regarding components
text: Specific provisions on valves activated by an electric/external (hydraulic, pneumatic) power

heading: Specifications regarding the various components of the LPG equipment > General design rules regarding components > Provisions regarding the 80 per cent stop valve
text: In the case of valves activated by an electric/external power (e.g. 80 per cent stop valve, service valve, shut-off valves, non-return valves, gas tube pressure relief valve, service coupling), those valves shall be in "closed" position when their power is switched off.

heading: Specifications regarding the various components of the LPG equipment > General design rules regarding components > Provisions regarding the 80 per cent stop valve
text: The power of the fuel pump shall be switched off when the electronic control unit becomes defective or loses power.

heading: Specifications regarding the various components of the LPG equipment > General design rules regarding components > Provisions regarding the 80 per cent stop valve
text: Without prejudice to paragraph 1.7. of Annex 7 of this Regulation (commanded stop phases), a remotely controlled shut-off valve (when intended to be fitted as a component of an interconnected LPG-system for the purpose of paragraph 17.13.2.2.) shall be submitted, during approval, to an endurance test according to paragraph 9. of Annex 16 with a number of cycles equal to 20,000. The valve shall bear a marking with the following data clearly legible and indelible: (a) The wording "ICS", and (b) The approval mark according to paragraph 5.4. of this Regulation.

heading: Specifications regarding the various components of the LPG equipment > General design rules regarding components
title: Heat exchange medium (compatibility and pressure requirements)
text: Heat exchange medium (compatibility and pressure requirements)

heading: Specifications regarding the various components of the LPG equipment > General design rules regarding components > Heat exchange medium (compatibility and pressure requirements)
text: The materials constituting a device which are in contact with the heat exchange medium of a device when operating shall be compatible with that fluid and shall be designed to withstand a pressure of 200 kPa of the heat exchange medium. The material shall meet the prescriptions laid down in Annex 15, paragraph 17.

heading: Specifications regarding the various components of the LPG equipment > General design rules regarding components > Heat exchange medium (compatibility and pressure requirements)
text: The compartment containing the heat exchange medium of the vaporizer/pressure regulator shall be leak proof at a pressure of 200 kPa.

heading: Specifications regarding the various components of the LPG equipment > General design rules regarding components
text: A component consisting of both high pressure and low pressure parts shall be so designed to prevent a pressure build up in the low pressure part above 2.25 times the maximum working pressure for which it has been tested. Components connected directly to the tank pressure shall be designed for the classification pressure of 3,000 kPa. Venting to the motor compartment or outside of the vehicle is not allowed.

heading: Specifications regarding the various components of the LPG equipment > General design rules regarding components
title: Specific provisions to prevent any gas flow
text: Specific provisions to prevent any gas flow

heading: Specifications regarding the various components of the LPG equipment > General design rules regarding components > Specific provisions to prevent any gas flow
text: Pumps of Class 1 shall be so designed that the outlet pressure never exceeds 3,000 kPa, when there is e.g. blocking of the tubing or not opening of a shut-off valve. This can be realized by switching off the pump or by recirculating to the container. Pumps of Class 0 shall be so designed that the outlet pressure never exceeds the WP of the components downstream of the pump, when there is, e.g. blocking of the tubing or not opening of a shut-off valve. This can be realized by switching off the pump or by recirculation to the container.

heading: Specifications regarding the various components of the LPG equipment > General design rules regarding components > Specific provisions to prevent any gas flow
text: The pressure regulator/vaporizer shall be so designed as to prevent any gas flow when the regulator/vaporizer unit is supplied with LPG at a pressure ≤ 4,500 kPa when the regulator is not operating.

heading: Specifications regarding the various components of the LPG equipment > General design rules regarding components
title: Provisions regarding the gas tube relief valve
text: Provisions regarding the gas tube relief valve

heading: Specifications regarding the various components of the LPG equipment > General design rules regarding components > Provisions regarding the gas tube relief valve
text: Gas-tube pressure relief valves of Class 1 shall be so designed as to open at a pressure of 3,200 ± 100 kPa. Gas-tube pressure relief valves of Class 0 shall be so designed as to open at a pressure of 1.07 WP of the pipe ± 100 kPa (if needed).

heading: Specifications regarding the various components of the LPG equipment > General design rules regarding components > Provisions regarding the gas tube relief valve
text: Gas-tube pressure relief valves of Class 1 shall not have internal leakage up to 3,000 kPa. Gas-tube pressure relief valves of Class 0 shall not have internal leakage up to WP of the pipe.

heading: Specifications regarding the various components of the LPG equipment > General design rules regarding components
title: Provisions regarding the pressure relief valve (discharge valve)
text: Provisions regarding the pressure relief valve (discharge valve)

heading: Specifications regarding the various components of the LPG equipment > General design rules regarding components > Provisions regarding the pressure relief valve (discharge valve)
text: The pressure relief valve shall be mounted inside the container or on the container, in the area where the fuel is in gaseous state.

heading: Specifications regarding the various components of the LPG equipment > General design rules regarding components > Provisions regarding the pressure relief valve (discharge valve)
text: The pressure relief valve shall be so designed as to open at a pressure of 2,700 ± 100 kPa.

heading: Specifications regarding the various components of the LPG equipment > General design rules regarding components > Provisions regarding the pressure relief valve (discharge valve)
text: The flow capacity of the pressure relief valve, determined with compressed air at a pressure which is 20 per cent higher than the normal operating-pressure shall be at least Q ≥ 10.66 ∙ A0.82 In which: Q = flow of air in standard m3 /min (100 kPa absolute and temperature of 15 °C) A = exterior surface of the container in m2 . The flow test results shall be corrected to standard conditions: Air pressure of 100 kPa absolute and temperature of 15 °C. When the pressure relief valve is considered as a pressure relief device, the flow shall be at least 17.7 standard m3 /min.

heading: Specifications regarding the various components of the LPG equipment > General design rules regarding components > Provisions regarding the pressure relief valve (discharge valve)
text: The pressure relief valve shall not have internal leakage up to 2,600 kPa.

heading: Specifications regarding the various components of the LPG equipment > General design rules regarding components > Provisions regarding the pressure relief valve (discharge valve)
text: The pressure relief device (fuse) shall be designed to open at a temperature of 120 ± 10 °C.

heading: Specifications regarding the various components of the LPG equipment > General design rules regarding components > Provisions regarding the pressure relief valve (discharge valve)
text: The pressure relief device (fuse) shall be designed to have, when opened, a flow capacity of: Q ≥ 2.73 ∙ A In which: Q = flow of air in standard m3/min (100 kPa absolute and temperature of 15 °C) A = exterior surface of the container in m2 . The flow test shall be carried out at an upstream air pressure of 200 kPa absolute, and at temperature of 15 °C. The flow test results shall be corrected to standard conditions: Air pressure of 100 kPa absolute, and temperature of 15 °C.

heading: Specifications regarding the various components of the LPG equipment > General design rules regarding components > Provisions regarding the pressure relief valve (discharge valve)
text: The pressure relief device shall be mounted on the container in the gaseous zone.

heading: Specifications regarding the various components of the LPG equipment > General design rules regarding components > Provisions regarding the pressure relief valve (discharge valve)
text: The pressure relief device shall be fitted to the container in such a manner that it can discharge into the gas tight housing, when its presence is prescribed.

heading: Specifications regarding the various components of the LPG equipment > General design rules regarding components > Provisions regarding the pressure relief valve (discharge valve)
text: The pressure relief device (fuse) shall be tested according to the provisions described in Annex 3, paragraph 7.

heading: Specifications regarding the various components of the LPG equipment > General design rules regarding components
text: Power dissipation of the fuel pump At minimum fuel level whereby the engine is still operating the heat build-up by the fuel pump(s) should never cause the pressure relief valve to open.

heading: Specifications regarding the various components of the LPG equipment > General design rules regarding components
title: Provisions regarding the filling unit
text: Provisions regarding the filling unit

heading: Specifications regarding the various components of the LPG equipment > General design rules regarding components > Provisions regarding the filling unit
text: The filling unit shall be equipped with at least one soft-seated non-return valve, and it shall not be dismountable by design.

heading: Specifications regarding the various components of the LPG equipment > General design rules regarding components > Provisions regarding the filling unit
text: The filling unit shall be protected against contamination.

heading: Specifications regarding the various components of the LPG equipment > General design rules regarding components > Provisions regarding the filling unit
text: The design and dimensions of the connecting area of the filling unit shall comply with those in the figures in Annex 9. The filling unit shown in Figure 5 is only applicable for motor vehicles of categories M2, M3, N2, N3 and M1 having a maximum total mass > 3,500 kg.

heading: Specifications regarding the various components of the LPG equipment > General design rules regarding components > Provisions regarding the filling unit
text: The filling unit shown in Figure 4 may also apply for motor vehicles of categories M2, M3, N2, N3 and M1 having a maximum total mass > 3,500 kg.3 3As defined in the Consolidated Resolution on the Construction of Vehicles (R.E.3.), document ECE/TRANS/WP.29/78/Rev.3, para. 2. http://www.unece.org/trans/main/wp29/wp29wgs/wp29gen/wp29resolutions.html

heading: Specifications regarding the various components of the LPG equipment > General design rules regarding components > Provisions regarding the filling unit
text: The outside filling unit is connected to the container by a hose or pipe.

heading: Specifications regarding the various components of the LPG equipment > General design rules regarding components > Provisions regarding the filling unit
text: Specific provisions regarding the K15 filling unit (Annex 9 – Figure 3):

heading: Specifications regarding the various components of the LPG equipment > General design rules regarding components > Provisions regarding the filling unit
text: The dead volume between the front sealing surface and the front of the non-return valve shall not exceed 0.1 cm3 ;

heading: Specifications regarding the various components of the LPG equipment > General design rules regarding components > Provisions regarding the filling unit
text: The flow through the connector at a pressure difference of 30 kPa shall be at least 60 litres/min, if tested with water.

heading: Specifications regarding the various components of the LPG equipment > General design rules regarding components > Provisions regarding the filling unit
text: Specific provisions regarding the heavy-duty vehicle Euro filling unit (Annex 9 - Figure 5):

heading: Specifications regarding the various components of the LPG equipment > General design rules regarding components > Provisions regarding the filling unit
text: The dead volume between the front sealing surface and the front of the non-return valve shall not exceed 0.5 cm3 ;

heading: Specifications regarding the various components of the LPG equipment > General design rules regarding components > Provisions regarding the filling unit
text: The flow through the filling unit, with the non-return valve mechanically opened, at a pressure difference of 50 kPa shall be at least 200 litres/min, when tested with water.

heading: Specifications regarding the various components of the LPG equipment > General design rules regarding components > Provisions regarding the filling unit
text: For vehicles of category M1, the filling unit shall not be located below the body of the vehicle and shall respect the height provisions of paragraph 17.4.5.

heading: Specifications regarding the various components of the LPG equipment > General design rules regarding components
title: Provisions regarding the level indicator
text: Provisions regarding the level indicator

heading: Specifications regarding the various components of the LPG equipment > General design rules regarding components > Provisions regarding the level indicator
text: The device to verify the level of liquid in the container shall be of an indirect type (for example magnetic) between the inside and outside of the container. If the device to verify the level of liquid in the container is of a direct type, the electric power connections should meet IP54 specifications according to IEC EN 60529:1997-06.

heading: Specifications regarding the various components of the LPG equipment > General design rules regarding components > Provisions regarding the level indicator
text: If the level indicator of the container comprises a float, the latter shall withstand an outside pressure of 3,000 kPa.

heading: Specifications regarding the various components of the LPG equipment > General design rules regarding components
text: Provisions regarding the gas tight housing of the container.

heading: Specifications regarding the various components of the LPG equipment > General design rules regarding components > Provisions regarding the level indicator
text: The gas-tight housing outlet shall have a total free cross-section of at least 450 mm2 .

heading: Specifications regarding the various components of the LPG equipment > General design rules regarding components > Provisions regarding the level indicator
text: The gas-tight housing shall be leak-proof at a pressure of 10 kPa with the aperture(s) closed off, maximum allowed leak rate of 100 cm3 /h vapour and show no permanent deformation.

heading: Specifications regarding the various components of the LPG equipment > General design rules regarding components > Provisions regarding the level indicator
text: The gas-tight housing shall be designed to withstand a pressure of 50 kPa.

heading: Specifications regarding the various components of the LPG equipment > General design rules regarding components
text: Provisions regarding the remotely controlled service valve with excess flow valve.

heading: Specifications regarding the various components of the LPG equipment > General design rules regarding components > Provisions regarding the level indicator
text: Provisions regarding the service valve

heading: Specifications regarding the various components of the LPG equipment > General design rules regarding components > Provisions regarding the level indicator
text: In case of the service valve is combined with a LPG fuel supply pump, identification of the pump shall be realised by the marking "PUMP INSIDE" and the identification of the pump either on the marking plate of the LPG container or on the multivalve if present. Electrical connections inside the LPG container shall comply with protection degree class IP 40 according to IEC Standard 60529-1989+A1:1999.

heading: Specifications regarding the various components of the LPG equipment > General design rules regarding components > Provisions regarding the level indicator
text: Service valves of Class 1 shall withstand a pressure of 6,750 kPa in the open and closed position. Service valves of Class 0 shall withstand a pressure of 2.25 WP in the open and closed position.

heading: Specifications regarding the various components of the LPG equipment > General design rules regarding components > Provisions regarding the level indicator
text: The service valve shall not, at the shut-off position, allow an internal leak rate in the flow direction. There may be leak in the back flow direction.

heading: Specifications regarding the various components of the LPG equipment > General design rules regarding components > Provisions regarding the level indicator
text: Provisions regarding the excess flow valve

heading: Specifications regarding the various components of the LPG equipment > General design rules regarding components > Provisions regarding the level indicator
text: The excess flow valve shall be mounted inside the container.

heading: Specifications regarding the various components of the LPG equipment > General design rules regarding components > Provisions regarding the level indicator
text: The excess flow valve shall be designed with a bypass to allow for equalization of pressures.

heading: Specifications regarding the various components of the LPG equipment > General design rules regarding components > Provisions regarding the level indicator
text: The excess flow valve shall cut off at a pressure difference over the valve of 90 kPa. At this pressure difference the flow shall not exceed 8,000 cm3 /min.

heading: Specifications regarding the various components of the LPG equipment > General design rules regarding components > Provisions regarding the level indicator
text: When the excess flow valve is at cut-off position, the flow through the by-pass shall not exceed 500 cm3 /min. at a differential pressure of 700 kPa.

heading: Specifications regarding the various components of the LPG equipment > General design rules regarding components
title: Provisions regarding non-return valves
text: Provisions regarding non-return valves

heading: Specifications regarding the various components of the LPG equipment > General design rules regarding components > Provisions regarding non-return valves
text: When a non-return valve is intended to be fitted as a component of an interconnected LPG-system for the purpose of paragraph 17.13.1.1., 17.13.1.2. or 17.13.2.1., it shall be submitted, during approval, to an endurance test according to paragraph 9.7. of Annex 16. The valve shall bear a marking with the following data clearly legible and indelible: (a) The wording "ICS", and (b) The approval mark according to paragraph 5.4. of this Regulation.

heading: Specifications regarding the various components of the LPG equipment
text: When intended to be fitted as components or parts of an interconnected LPG-system, non-metallic, metallic or a mixture of metallic and non-metallic LPG components, including flexible hoses and their elements, and nonmetallic, metallic or a mixture of metallic and non-metallic parts of LPG components which may come into contact with petrol shall meet the requirements specified in Annex 19 to this Regulation. Non-metallic, metallic or a mixture of metallic and non-metallic components or components containing nonmetallic parts shall bear an approval mark according to Annex A, Appendix 1.

title: Modifications of a type of LPG equipment and extension of approval
text: Modifications of a type of LPG equipment and extension of approval

heading: Modifications of a type of LPG equipment and extension of approval
text: Every modification of a type of LPG equipment shall be notified to the Type Approval Authority which granted the type approval. The Type Approval Authority may then either:

heading: Modifications of a type of LPG equipment and extension of approval
text: Consider that the modifications made are unlikely to have an appreciable adverse effect, and that the equipment still complies with the requirements; or

heading: Modifications of a type of LPG equipment and extension of approval
text: Consider whether retesting will be partial or complete.

heading: Modifications of a type of LPG equipment and extension of approval
text: Confirmation or refusal of approval, specifying the alterations, shall be communicated by the procedure specified in paragraph 5.3. above to the Parties to the Agreement which apply this Regulation.

heading: Modifications of a type of LPG equipment and extension of approval
text: The Type Approval Authority issuing the extension of approval shall assign a series number to each communication form drawn up for such an extension.

title: (Not allocated)
text: (Not allocated)
Conformity of production The conformity of production procedures shall comply with those set out in the Agreement, Appendix 2 (E/ECE/324-E/ECE/TRANS/505/Rev.2), with the following requirements:

heading: (Not allocated)
text: All equipment approved under this Regulation shall be so manufactured as to conform to the type approved by meeting the requirements of paragraph 6. above.

heading: (Not allocated)
text: In order to verify that the requirements of paragraph 9.1. are met, suitable controls of production shall be carried out.

heading: (Not allocated)
text: The minimum requirements for conformity of production control tests set forth in Annexes 8, 10 and 16 to this Regulation shall be complied with.

heading: (Not allocated)
text: The Type Approval Authority which has granted type approval may at any time verify the conformity control methods applied in each production facility. The normal frequency of these verifications shall be once every year.

heading: (Not allocated)
text: Moreover, each container shall be tested at a minimum pressure of 3,000 kPa in conformity with the prescriptions of paragraph 2.3. of Annex 10 to this Regulation.

heading: (Not allocated)
text: Every hose assembly which is applied in the high pressure class (Class 1) according to the classification as prescribed in paragraph 2. of this Regulation, shall, during half a minute, be subjected to a test with gas under a pressure of 3,000 kPa by the approval holder.

heading: (Not allocated)
text: Every hose assembly which is applied in the high pressure class (Class 0) according to the classification as prescribed in paragraph 2. of this Regulation, shall, during half a minute, be subjected to a test with gas under a pressure of the declared WP by the approval holder.

heading: (Not allocated)
text: For welded containers at least 1 per 200 containers and one of the remaining number has to be subjected to the radiographic examination according to Annex 10, paragraph 2.4.1.

heading: (Not allocated)
text: During production 1 of 200 containers and 1 of the remaining number has to be subjected to the abovementioned mechanical tests as described in Annex 10, paragraph 2.1.2.

title: Penalties for non-conformity of production
text: Penalties for non-conformity of production

heading: Penalties for non-conformity of production
text: The approval granted in respect of a type of equipment pursuant to this Regulation may be withdrawn if the requirements laid down in paragraph 9. above are not complied with.

heading: Penalties for non-conformity of production
text: If a Party to the Agreement applying this Regulation withdraws an approval it has previously granted, it shall forthwith so notify the other Contracting Parties applying this Regulation, by means of a communication form conforming to the model in Annex 2B to this Regulation.

title: Transitional provisions regarding the various components of the LPG equipment
text: Transitional provisions regarding the various components of the LPG equipment

heading: Transitional provisions regarding the various components of the LPG equipment
text: As from the official date of entry into force of the 01 series of amendments to this Regulation, no Contracting Party applying this Regulation shall refuse to grant approval under this Regulation as amended by the 01 series of amendments.

heading: Transitional provisions regarding the various components of the LPG equipment
text: As from 3 months after the official date of entry into force of the 01 series of amendments to this Regulation, Contracting Parties applying this Regulation shall grant approvals only if the type of component to be approved meets the requirements of this Regulation as amended by the 01 series of amendments.

heading: Transitional provisions regarding the various components of the LPG equipment
text: No Contracting Party applying this Regulation shall refuse a type of component approved to the 01 series of amendments to this Regulation.

heading: Transitional provisions regarding the various components of the LPG equipment
text: Until 12 months after the date of entry into force of the 01 series of amendments to this Regulation, no Contracting Party applying this Regulation shall refuse a type of component approved to this Regulation in its original form.

heading: Transitional provisions regarding the various components of the LPG equipment
text: Upon the expiration of a period of 12 months after the date of entry into force of the 01 series of amendments, Contracting Parties applying this Regulation may refuse the sale of a type of component which does not meet the requirements of the 01 series of amendments to this Regulation, unless the component is intended as a replacement for fitting on vehicles in use.

heading: Transitional provisions regarding the various components of the LPG equipment
text: As from 1 September 2022, Contracting Parties applying this Regulation may refuse the sale of a type of component which does not meet the requirements of the 02 series of amendments to this Regulation, unless the component is intended as a replacement for fitting on vehicles in use.

Production definitively discontinued If the holder of the approval completely ceases to manufacture a type of equipment approved in accordance with this Regulation, he shall so inform the Type Approval Authority which granted the approval.  Upon receiving the relevant communication, that Authority shall inform thereof the other Contracting Parties to the Agreement applying this Regulation by means of a communication form conforming to the model in Annex 2B to this Regulation.

Names and addresses of Technical Services responsible for conducting approval tests, and of Type Approval Authorities The Contracting Parties to the Agreement applying this Regulation shall communicate to the United Nations Secretariat the names and addresses of the Technical Services responsible for conducting approval tests and of the Type Approval Authorities which grant approval and to which forms certifying approval or extension or refusal or withdrawal of approval, issued in other countries, are to be sent. Part II - Approval of vehicles of categories M and N fitted with specific equipment for the use of liquefied petroleum gases in their propulsion system with regard to the installation of such equipment

title: Definitions
text: Definitions

heading: Definitions
text: For the purposes of Part II of this Regulation:

heading: Definitions
text: " _Approval of a vehicle_ " means the approval of a vehicle type with regard to the installation of its specific equipment for the use of liquefied petroleum gases in its propulsion system;

heading: Definitions
text: " _Vehicle type_ " means a vehicle or a family of vehicles fitted with specific equipment for the use of LPG in its propulsion system, which do not differ with respect to the following conditions:

heading: Definitions
text: The manufacturer;

heading: Definitions
text: The type designation established by the manufacturer;

heading: Definitions
text: The essential aspects of design and construction;

heading: Definitions
text: Chassis/floor pan (obvious and fundamental differences);

heading: Definitions
text: Installation of the LPG equipment (obvious and fundamental differences).

heading: Definitions
text: " _Commanded stop phase_ " defines the period of time during which the combustion engine is switched off automatically for fuel saving and is allowed to start again automatically.

title: Application for approval
text: Application for approval

heading: Application for approval
text: The application for approval of a vehicle type with regard to the installation of specific equipment for the use of liquefied petroleum gases in its propulsion system shall be submitted by the vehicle manufacturer or by his duly accredited representative.

heading: Application for approval
text: It shall be accompanied by the undermentioned documents in triplicate: description of the vehicle comprising all the relevant particulars referred to in Annex 1 to this Regulation.

heading: Application for approval
text: A vehicle representative of the vehicle type to be approved shall be submitted to the Technical Service conducting the approval tests.

title: Approval
text: Approval

heading: Approval
text: If the vehicle submitted for approval pursuant to this Regulation is provided with all the necessary specific equipment for the use of liquefied petroleum gases in its propulsion system and meets the requirements of paragraph 17. below, approval of that vehicle type shall be granted.

heading: Approval
text: An approval number shall be assigned to each type of vehicle approved in accordance with Schedule 4 of the Agreement (E/ECE/TRANS/505/Rev.3).

heading: Approval
text: Notice of approval or of refusal or of extension of approval of an LPG vehicle type pursuant to this Regulation shall be communicated to the Parties to the Agreement applying this Regulation, by means of a form conforming to the model in Annex 2D to this Regulation.

heading: Approval
text: There shall be affixed, conspicuously and in a readily accessible space specified on the approval form referred to in paragraph 16.3. above, to every vehicle type approved under this Regulation an international approval mark consisting of:

heading: Approval
text: A circle surrounding the letter "E" followed by the distinguishing number of the country which has granted approval.4 4The distinguish numbers of the Contracting Parties to the 1958 Agreement are reproduced in Annex 3 to the Consolidated Resolution on the Construction of Vehicles (R.E.3), document ECE/TRANS/WP.29/78/Rev.3 http://www.unece.org/trans/main/wp29/wp29wgs/wp29gen/wp29resolutions.html

heading: Approval
text: The number of this Regulation, followed by the letter "R", a dash and the approval number to the right of the circle prescribed in paragraph 16.4.1. above.

heading: Approval
text: If the vehicle conforms to a vehicle approved, under one or more other Regulations annexed to the Agreement, in the country which has granted approval under this Regulation, the symbol prescribed in paragraph 16.4.1. above need not be repeated; in such case, the Regulation and approval numbers and the additional symbols of all the Regulations under which approval has been granted in the country which has granted approval under this Regulation shall be placed in vertical columns to the right of the symbol prescribed in paragraph 16.4.1. above.

heading: Approval
text: The approval mark shall be clearly legible and be indelible.

heading: Approval
text: The approval mark shall be placed close to or on the vehicle data plate.

heading: Approval
text: Annex 2C to this Regulation gives examples of the arrangement of the aforesaid approval mark.
Requirements for the installation of specific equipment for the use of liquefied petroleum gases in the propulsion system of a vehicle

heading: Approval
title: General
text: General

heading: Approval > General
text: The LPG equipment as installed in the vehicle shall function in such a manner that the working pressure for which it has been designed and approved cannot be exceeded.

heading: Approval > General
text: All parts of the system shall be type approved for individual parts pursuant to Part I of this Regulation.

heading: Approval > General
text: Notwithstanding the provisions of paragraph 17.1.2. above, if the LPG electronic control unit is integrated into the engine electronic control unit and is covered with a vehicle installation type approval according to Part II of this Regulation and to Regulation No. 10, no separate type approval of the LPG electronic control unit is necessary. The vehicle type approval shall also be approved pursuant to the applicable provisions laid down in Annex 14 to this Regulation.

heading: Approval > General
text: The materials used in the system shall be suitable for use with LPG.

heading: Approval > General
text: All parts of the system shall be fastened in a proper way.

heading: Approval > General
text: The LPG system shall show no leaks.

heading: Approval > General
text: The LPG system shall be installed such that is has the best possible protection against damage, such as damage due to moving vehicle components, collision, grit or due to the loading or unloading of the vehicle or the shifting of those loads.

heading: Approval > General
text: Notwithstanding the provisions of paragraph 17.1.6., it shall be possible to make an external inspection (e.g. for periodic technical inspection) of the LPG-container and its accessories, when located outside the vehicle, according to the specifications of the manufacturer, without the use of tools to dismantle, but with visual aids, e.g. lamps, mirrors or endoscopes.

heading: Approval > General
text: No appliances shall be connected to the LPG system other than those strictly required for the proper operation of the engine of the motor vehicle.

heading: Approval > General
text: Notwithstanding the provisions of paragraph 17.1.7. above, motor vehicles of categories M2, M3, N2, N3 and M1 having either a maximum total mass > 3500 kg or a body type SA1 5 , may be fitted with a heating system to heat the passenger compartment which is connected to the LPG system. 5As defined in the Consolidated Resolution on the Construction of Vehicles (R.E.3.), document ECE/TRANS/WP.29/78/Rev.3, para. 2. http://www.unece.org/trans/main/wp29/wp29wgs/wp29gen/wp29resolutions.html

heading: Approval > General
text: The heating system referred to in paragraph 17.1.7.1. above shall be permitted if, in the view of the Technical Services responsible for conducting type approval, the heating system is adequately protected and the required operation of the normal LPG system is not affected.

heading: Approval > General
text: Notwithstanding the provisions of paragraph 17.1.7. above, a mono-fuel vehicle without limp-home system may be equipped with a service coupling in the LPG system.

heading: Approval > General
text: The service coupling referred to in paragraph 17.1.7.3. above shall be permitted if, in the view of the Technical Services responsible for conducting type approval, the service coupling is adequately protected and the required operation of the normal LPG system is not affected. The service coupling shall be combined with a separate gas-tight non-return valve whereby it is only possible to operate the engine.

heading: Approval > General
text: Mono-fuel vehicles installed with a service coupling shall carry a sticker near the service coupling as specified in Annex 18 to this Regulation.

heading: Approval > General
title: Identification of LPG-fuelled vehicles
text: Identification of LPG-fuelled vehicles

heading: Approval > General > Identification of LPG-fuelled vehicles
text: Vehicles of categories M2/N2 and M3/N3 shall be labelled as specified in Annex 17.

heading: Approval > General > Identification of LPG-fuelled vehicles
text: These labels shall be placed on the front of the vehicle and on the left side as well as on the right side of the vehicle; for the side if available in vicinity of a front door. If there is no front door available, the label has to be placed on the first third of the vehicle length. In addition, for vehicles of category M2 and M3, a label shall be fixed to the rear of the vehicle.

heading: Approval
title: Further requirements
text: Further requirements

heading: Approval > Further requirements
text: No component of the LPG system, including any protective materials which form part of such components, shall project beyond the external surface of the vehicle, with the exception of the filling unit if this does not project more than 10 mm beyond the nominal line of the body panel.

heading: Approval > Further requirements
text: With the exception of the LPG fuel container, in no cross section of the vehicle any component of the LPG system, including any protective material which forms part of such components, may extend beyond the lower edge of the vehicle unless another part of the vehicle, within a radius of 150 mm is situated lower.

heading: Approval > Further requirements
text: No component of the LPG system shall be located within 100 mm of the exhaust or similar heat source, unless such components are adequately shielded against heat.

heading: Approval
title: The LPG system
text: The LPG system

heading: Approval > The LPG system
text: An LPG system shall contain at least the following components:

heading: Approval > The LPG system
text: Fuel container; 17.3.1.2. 80 per cent stop valve;

heading: Approval > The LPG system
text: Level indicator;

heading: Approval > The LPG system
text: Pressure relief valve;

heading: Approval > The LPG system
text: Remotely controlled service valve with excess flow valve;

heading: Approval > The LPG system
text: Pressure regulator and vaporizer, which may be combined;6 > 6These components might not be necessary in case of liquid LPG injection.

heading: Approval > The LPG system
text: Remotely controlled shut-off valve;

heading: Approval > The LPG system
text: Filling unit;

heading: Approval > The LPG system
text: Gas tubes and hoses;

heading: Approval > The LPG system
text: Gas-carrying connections between the LPG system components;

heading: Approval > The LPG system
text: Injector or gas injection device or gas mixing piece;

heading: Approval > The LPG system
text: Electronic control unit;

heading: Approval > The LPG system
text: Pressure relief device (fuse).

heading: Approval > The LPG system
text: The system may also include the following components:

heading: Approval > The LPG system
text: Gas-tight housing, covering the accessories fitted to the fuel container;

heading: Approval > The LPG system
text: Non-return valve;

heading: Approval > The LPG system
text: Gas tube pressure relief valve;

heading: Approval > The LPG system
text: Gas dosage unit;

heading: Approval > The LPG system
text: LPG filter unit;

heading: Approval > The LPG system
text: Pressure or temperature sensor;

heading: Approval > The LPG system
text: LPG fuel pump;

heading: Approval > The LPG system
text: Power supply bushing for the container (actuators/fuel pump/fuel level sensor);

heading: Approval > The LPG system
text: Service coupling (mono-fuel vehicles only & no limp-home system);

heading: Approval > The LPG system
text: Fuel selection system and electrical system;

heading: Approval > The LPG system
text: Fuel rail.

heading: Approval > The LPG system
text: The container fittings referred to in paragraphs 17.3.1.2. to 17.3.1.5. above may be combined.

heading: Approval > The LPG system
text: The remotely controlled shut-off valve referred to in paragraph 17.3.1.7. above may be combined with the pressure regulator/vaporizer.

heading: Approval > The LPG system
text: Additional components required for the effective operation of the engine may be installed in that part of the LPG system where the pressure is less than 20 kPa.

heading: Approval
title: Installation of the fuel container
text: Installation of the fuel container

heading: Approval > Installation of the fuel container
text: The fuel container shall be permanently installed in the vehicle and shall not be installed in the engine compartment.

heading: Approval > Installation of the fuel container
text: The fuel container shall be installed in the correct position, according to the instructions from the container manufacturer.

heading: Approval > Installation of the fuel container
text: The fuel container shall be installed such that there is no metal to metal contact, other than at the permanent fixing points of the container.

heading: Approval > Installation of the fuel container
text: The fuel container shall have permanent fixing points to secure it to the motor vehicle or the container shall be secured to the motor vehicle by a container frame and container straps.

heading: Approval > Installation of the fuel container
text: When the vehicle is ready for use the fuel container shall not be less than 200 mm above the road surface.

heading: Approval > Installation of the fuel container
text: The provisions of paragraph 17.4.5. above shall not apply if the container is adequately protected, at the front and the sides and no part of the container is located lower than this protective structure.

heading: Approval > Installation of the fuel container
text: The fuel container(s) shall be mounted and fixed so that the following accelerations can be absorbed (without damage occurring) when the containers are full: Vehicles of categories M1 and N1: (a) 20 g in the direction of travel; (b) 8 g horizontally perpendicular to the direction of travel. Vehicles of categories M2 and N2: (a) 10 g in the direction of travel; (b) 5 g horizontally perpendicular to the direction of travel. Vehicles of categories M3 and N3: (a) 6.6 g in the direction of travel; (b) 5 g horizontally perpendicular to the direction of travel. A calculation method can be used instead of practical testing if its equivalence can be demonstrated by the applicant for approval to the satisfaction of the Technical Service.

heading: Approval
title: Further requirements to the fuel container
text: Further requirements to the fuel container

heading: Approval > Further requirements to the fuel container
text: If more than one LPG container is connected to a single delivery tube each container shall be fitted with a non-return valve installed downstream of the remotely controlled service valve and a tube pressure relief valve shall be installed in the delivery tube, downstream of the non-return valve. An adequate filter system has to be placed upstream of the non-return valve(s) to prevent fouling of the non-return valve(s).

heading: Approval > Further requirements to the fuel container
text: A non-return valve and tube pressure relief valve shall not be required if the backflow pressure of the remotely controlled service valve in the closed position exceeds 500 kPa. In that case the control of the remotely controlled service valves shall be constructed such that it is impossible for more than one remotely controlled valve to be open at any time. The overlap time to allow switching is limited to two minutes.

heading: Approval
title: Accessories to the fuel container
text: Accessories to the fuel container

heading: Approval > Accessories to the fuel container
title: Remotely controlled service valve with excess flow valve on the container
text: Remotely controlled service valve with excess flow valve on the container

heading: Approval > Accessories to the fuel container > Remotely controlled service valve with excess flow valve on the container
text: The remotely controlled service valve with excess flow valve shall be installed directly on the fuel container, without any intervening fittings.

heading: Approval > Accessories to the fuel container > Remotely controlled service valve with excess flow valve on the container
text: The remotely controlled service valve with excess flow valve shall be controlled such that it is automatically closed when the engine is not running, irrespective of the position of the ignition switch, and shall remain closed as long as the engine is not running.

heading: Approval > Accessories to the fuel container > Remotely controlled service valve with excess flow valve on the container
text: Notwithstanding the provision of paragraph 17.6.1.2.above , in case of liquid injection systems, if a fuel recirculation is required to purge the system from gas bubbles (vapour lock), it is allowed to keep the remotely controlled service valve with excess flow valve open for a period not longer than 10 seconds before starting the engine in LPG running mode.

heading: Approval > Accessories to the fuel container > Remotely controlled service valve with excess flow valve on the container
text: Notwithstanding the provisions of paragraph 17.6.1.2. above, the remotely controlled service valve may stay in an open position during the commanded stop phases.

heading: Approval > Accessories to the fuel container > Remotely controlled service valve with excess flow valve on the container
text: If the remotely controlled service valve is closed during commanded stop phases, the valve shall comply with paragraph 4.7. of Annex 3.

heading: Approval > Accessories to the fuel container
title: Spring-loaded pressure relief valve in the container
text: Spring-loaded pressure relief valve in the container

heading: Approval > Accessories to the fuel container > Spring-loaded pressure relief valve in the container
text: The spring-loaded pressure relief valve shall be installed in the fuel container in such a manner that it is connected to the vapour space and can discharge to the surrounding atmosphere. The spring-loaded pressure relief valve may discharge into the gas-tight housing if that gas-tight housing fulfils the requirements of paragraph 17.6.5. below. 17.6.3. 80 per cent stop valve

heading: Approval > Accessories to the fuel container > Spring-loaded pressure relief valve in the container
text: The automatic filling level limiter shall be suitable for the fuel container it is fitted to and shall be installed in the appropriate position to ensure that the container cannot be filled to more than 80 per cent.

heading: Approval > Accessories to the fuel container
title: Level indicator
text: Level indicator

heading: Approval > Accessories to the fuel container > Level indicator
text: The level indicator shall be suitable for the fuel container it is fitted to and shall be installed in the appropriate position.

heading: Approval > Accessories to the fuel container
title: Gas-tight housing on the container
text: Gas-tight housing on the container

heading: Approval > Accessories to the fuel container > Gas-tight housing on the container
text: A gas-tight housing over the container fittings, which fulfils the requirements of paragraphs 17.6.5.2. to 17.6.5.5. below shall be fitted to the fuel container, unless the container is installed outside the vehicle and the container fittings are protected against dirt and water.

heading: Approval > Accessories to the fuel container > Gas-tight housing on the container
text: The gas-tight housing shall be in open connection with the atmosphere, where necessary through a connecting hose and a lead-through.

heading: Approval > Accessories to the fuel container > Gas-tight housing on the container
text: The ventilation opening of the gas-tight housing shall point downwards at the point of exit from the motor vehicle. However, it shall not discharge into a wheel arch, nor shall it be aimed at a heat source such as the exhaust.

heading: Approval > Accessories to the fuel container > Gas-tight housing on the container
text: Any connecting hose and lead-through in the bottom of the bodywork of the motor vehicle for ventilation of the gas-tight housing shall have a minimum clear opening of 450 mm2 . If a gas tube, other tube or any electrical wiring is installed in the connecting hose and lead-through, the clear opening shall also be at least 450 mm2 .

heading: Approval > Accessories to the fuel container > Gas-tight housing on the container
text: The gas-tight housing and connecting hoses shall be gas-tight at a pressure of 10 kPa with the apertures closed off, and show no permanent deformation, with a maximum allowed leak rate of 100 cm3 /h.

heading: Approval > Accessories to the fuel container > Gas-tight housing on the container
text: The connecting hose shall be secured in a proper way to the gas-tight housing and the lead-through to ensure that a gas-tight joint is formed.

heading: Approval
title: Gas tubes and gas hoses
text: Gas tubes and gas hoses

heading: Approval > Gas tubes and gas hoses
text: Gas tubes of seamless type made of either copper or stainless steel or steel with corrosion-resistant coating.

heading: Approval > Gas tubes and gas hoses
text: If seamless copper is used the tube shall be protected by a rubber or plastic sleeve.

heading: Approval > Gas tubes and gas hoses
text: The outer diameter of Class 1 gas tubes made of copper shall not exceed 12 mm with a wall thickness of at least 0.8 mm, gas tubes of Class 1 from steel and stainless steel shall not exceed 25 mm with, for gas services, an appropriate wall thickness.

heading: Approval > Gas tubes and gas hoses
text: Gas tubes of seamless type made of materials other than those of paragraph 17.7.1. shall comply with the applicable tests according to the provisions of Annex 15

heading: Approval > Gas tubes and gas hoses
text: Gas tubes of non-seamless type shall comply with the applicable tests according to the provisions of Annex 15.

heading: Approval > Gas tubes and gas hoses
text: Gas pipes made of a non-metallic material shall comply with the requirements of this Regulation, paragraph 6.7.

heading: Approval > Gas tubes and gas hoses
text: The gas tube may be replaced by a gas hose if this hose fulfils the requirement of this Regulation, paragraph 6.7.

heading: Approval > Gas tubes and gas hoses
text: Gas tubes, other than non-metallic gas tubes, shall be secured such that they shall not be subjected to vibration or stresses.

heading: Approval > Gas tubes and gas hoses
text: Gas hoses and non-metallic gas tubes shall be secured such that they shall not be subjected to stresses.

heading: Approval > Gas tubes and gas hoses
text: At the fixing point the gas tube or hose shall be fitted with a protective material.

heading: Approval > Gas tubes and gas hoses
text: Gas tubes or hoses shall not be located at jacking points.

heading: Approval > Gas tubes and gas hoses
text: At passages the gas tubes or hoses, whether or not fitted with a protective sleeve, shall be fitted with protective material.

heading: Approval
title: Gas connections between the components of the LPG system
text: Gas connections between the components of the LPG system

heading: Approval > Gas connections between the components of the LPG system
text: Soldered or welded joints and bite-type compression joints are not permitted. Soldering or welding can be permitted for connecting the individual parts of detachable couplings to the gas tube or component.

heading: Approval > Gas connections between the components of the LPG system
text: Gas tubes shall only be connected by compatible fittings with regard to corrosion.

heading: Approval > Gas connections between the components of the LPG system
text: Stainless steel tubes shall only be joined by stainless steel fittings.

heading: Approval > Gas connections between the components of the LPG system
text: Distributing-blocks shall be made of corrosion-resistant material.

heading: Approval > Gas connections between the components of the LPG system
text: Gas tubes shall be connected by appropriate joints, for example, two-part compression joints in steel tubes and joints with olives tapered on both sides or two flanges in copper tubes. Gas tubes shall be connected with appropriate connections. Under no circumstances couplings may be used whereby the tube will be damaged. The burst pressure of the mounted couplings shall be the same or higher as specified for the tube.

heading: Approval > Gas connections between the components of the LPG system
text: The number of joints shall be limited to a minimum.

heading: Approval > Gas connections between the components of the LPG system
text: Any joints shall be made in locations where access is possible for inspection.

heading: Approval > Gas connections between the components of the LPG system
text: In a passenger compartment or enclosed luggage compartment the gas tube or hose shall be no longer than reasonably required; this provision is fulfilled when the gas tube or hose does not extend further than from the fuel container to the side of vehicle.

heading: Approval > Gas connections between the components of the LPG system
text: There shall be no gas-conveying connections in the passenger compartment or enclosed luggage compartment with the exception of: (a) The connections on the gas-tight housing; and (b) The connection between the gas tube or hose and the filling unit if this connection is fitted with a sleeve which is resistant against LPG and any leaking gas will be discharged directly into the atmosphere.

heading: Approval > Gas connections between the components of the LPG system
text: The provisions of paragraph 17.8.8. and paragraph 17.8.8.1. above shall not apply for M2 or M3 category vehicles if the gas tubes or hoses and connections are fitted with a sleeve which is resistant against LPG and which has an open connection to the atmosphere. The open end of the sleeve or ducting shall be situated at the lowest point.

heading: Approval
title: Remotely controlled shut-off valve
text: Remotely controlled shut-off valve

heading: Approval > Remotely controlled shut-off valve
text: A remotely controlled shut-off valve shall be installed in the gas tube from the LPG container to the pressure regulator/vaporizer, as close as possible to the pressure regulator/vaporizer.

heading: Approval > Remotely controlled shut-off valve
text: The remotely controlled shut-off valve may be incorporated into the pressure regulator/vaporizer.

heading: Approval > Remotely controlled shut-off valve
text: Notwithstanding the provisions of paragraph 17.9.1. above, the remotely controlled shut-off valve may be installed at a location in the engine bay specified by the manufacturer of the LPG system if a fuel return system is provided between the pressure regulator and the LPG container.

heading: Approval > Remotely controlled shut-off valve
text: The remotely controlled shut-off valve shall be installed such that the fuel supply is cut off when the engine is not running or, if the vehicle is also equipped with another fuel system, when the other fuel is selected. A delay of 2 seconds is permitted for diagnostic purposes.

heading: Approval > Remotely controlled shut-off valve
text: Notwithstanding the provision of paragraph 17.9.4. above, in case of liquid injection systems, if a fuel recirculation is required to purge the system from gas bubbles (vapour lock), it is allowed to keep the remotely controlled shut-off valve open for a period not longer than 10 seconds before starting the engine in LPG running mode and during the fuel switching-over.

heading: Approval > Remotely controlled shut-off valve
text: Notwithstanding the provisions of paragraph 17.9.4. above, the remotely controlled shut-off valve may stay in an open position during the commanded stop phases.

heading: Approval > Remotely controlled shut-off valve
text: If the remotely controlled shut-off valve is closed during commanded stop phases, the valve shall comply with paragraph 1.7. of Annex 7.17.10. Filling unit

heading: Approval > Remotely controlled shut-off valve
text: The filling unit shall be secured against rotation and shall be protected against dirt and water.

heading: Approval > Remotely controlled shut-off valve
text: When the LPG container is installed in the passenger compartment or an enclosed (luggage) compartment, the filling unit shall be located at the outside of the vehicle.

heading: Approval > Remotely controlled shut-off valve
text: For vehicles of category M1, the filling unit shall not be located below the body of the vehicle and shall respect the height provisions of paragraph 17.4.5.

heading: Approval
title: Fuel selection system and electrical installation
text: Fuel selection system and electrical installation

heading: Approval > Fuel selection system and electrical installation
text: The electrical components of the LPG system shall be protected against overloads and at least one separate fuse shall be provided in the supply cable.

heading: Approval > Fuel selection system and electrical installation
text: The fuse shall be installed in a known location where it can be reached without the use of tools.

heading: Approval > Fuel selection system and electrical installation
text: The electrical power to LPG system components which also carry gas may not be conducted by a gas tube.

heading: Approval > Fuel selection system and electrical installation
text: All electrical components installed in a part of the LPG system where the pressure exceeds 20 kPa shall be connected and insulated in a manner that no current is led through LPG containing parts.

heading: Approval > Fuel selection system and electrical installation
text: Electrical cables shall be adequately protected against damage. The electrical connections inside the boot and passengers compartment shall comply with protection degree class IP 40 according to IEC Standard 605291989+A1:1999. All other electrical connections shall comply with protection degree class IP 54 according to IEC Standard 60529-1989+A1:1999.

heading: Approval > Fuel selection system and electrical installation
text: Vehicles with more than one fuel system shall have a fuel selection system

heading: Approval > Fuel selection system and electrical installation
text: The electrical connections and components in the gas-tight housing shall be constructed such that no sparks are generated.

heading: Approval
title: Pressure relief device
text: Pressure relief device

heading: Approval > Pressure relief device
text: The pressure relief device shall be fitted to the fuel container(s) in such a manner that it can discharge into the gas tight housing, when its presence is prescribed, if that gas tight housing fulfils the requirements of paragraph 17.6.5. above.

heading: Approval
title: Specific provisions for interconnected LPG-systems
text: Specific provisions for interconnected LPG-systems

heading: Approval > Specific provisions for interconnected LPG-systems
title: LPG-system for dual-fuel (LPG-diesel) vehicle
text: LPG-system for dual-fuel (LPG-diesel) vehicle

heading: Approval > Specific provisions for interconnected LPG-systems > LPG-system for dual-fuel (LPG-diesel) vehicle
text: Means shall be provided to prevent any flow of LPG into the diesel tank. The installation of two nonreturn valves along the flow line shall be considered as meeting this requirement if the valves comply with the provisions of paragraph 6.17.14.1.

heading: Approval > Specific provisions for interconnected LPG-systems > LPG-system for dual-fuel (LPG-diesel) vehicle
text: Means shall be provided to prevent any flow of diesel into the LPG container. The installation of two non-return valves along the flow line shall be considered as meeting this requirement if the valves comply with the provisions of paragraph 6.17.14.1.

heading: Approval > Specific provisions for interconnected LPG-systems
title: LPG-system for bi-fuel (LPG-petrol) vehicle
text: LPG-system for bi-fuel (LPG-petrol) vehicle

heading: Approval > Specific provisions for interconnected LPG-systems > LPG-system for bi-fuel (LPG-petrol) vehicle
text: Means shall be provided to prevent any flow of LPG into the petrol tank. The installation of two nonreturn valves along the flow line shall be considered as meeting this requirement if the valves comply with the provisions of paragraph 6.17.14.1.

heading: Approval > Specific provisions for interconnected LPG-systems > LPG-system for bi-fuel (LPG-petrol) vehicle
text: In order to prevent that flows of petrol into LPG container, occurring during switch-over operations, could lead to an overfilling of the LPG tank (i.e. above 80 per cent of its capacity which means 80 per cent liquid and 20 per cent gaseous fuel), the LPG-system shall contain an Electronic Control Unit complying also with paragraph 6. of Annex 14. A remotely controlled shut-off valve complying with the provisions of paragraph 6.17.3.3. shall be installed along the flow line.

heading: Approval > Specific provisions for interconnected LPG-systems > LPG-system for bi-fuel (LPG-petrol) vehicle
text: Means shall be provided to prevent that flows of petrol into the LPG fuel container could lead to a content of petrol higher than 16 per cent of the actual volume contained in the LPG tank. This measure shall be demonstrated in accordance with the procedures laid down in Annex 20. The present requirement shall be fulfilled also in case of faults by use of a malfunction indication to the driver, and optionally activation of limp home mode.

heading: Approval > Specific provisions for interconnected LPG-systems > LPG-system for bi-fuel (LPG-petrol) vehicle
text: Non-metallic, metallic or a mixture of metallic and non-metallic LPG components, including flexible hoses and their elements, and non-metallic, metallic or a mixture of metallic and non-metallic parts of LPG components which may come into contact with petrol shall comply with the requirements set out in paragraph 6.18.

heading: Approval > Specific provisions for interconnected LPG-systems > LPG-system for bi-fuel (LPG-petrol) vehicle
text: The ECU complying with the requirements of paragraph 17.13.2.2. shall be installed: (a) In vehicles where the flushed volume is less than or equal to 0.4 litre; and (b) In vehicles equipped with a LPG container having a capacity higher than 20 litres."
Conformity of production The conformity of production procedures shall comply with those set out in the Agreement, Appendix 2 (E/ECE/324-E/ECE/TRANS/505/Rev.2) with the following requirements:

heading: Approval
text: All vehicles approved under this Regulation shall be so manufactured as to conform to the type approved by meeting the requirements of paragraph 17. above.

heading: Approval
text: In order to verify that the requirements of paragraph 18.1. above are met, suitable controls of the production shall be carried out.

heading: Approval
text: The Type Approval Authority which has granted type approval may at any time verify the conformity control methods applied in each production facility. The normal frequency of these verifications shall be once every year.

title: Penalties for non-conformity of production
text: Penalties for non-conformity of production

heading: Penalties for non-conformity of production
text: The approval granted in respect of a type of vehicle pursuant to this Regulation may be withdrawn if the requirements laid down in paragraph 18. above are not complied with.

heading: Penalties for non-conformity of production
text: If a Contracting Party to the Agreement applying this Regulation withdraws an approval it has previously granted, it shall forthwith so notify the other Contracting Parties applying this Regulation, by means of a communication form conforming to the model in Annex 2D to this Regulation.

title: Modification and extension of approval of a vehicle type
text: Modification and extension of approval of a vehicle type

heading: Modification and extension of approval of a vehicle type
text: Every modification of the installation of the specific equipment for the use of liquefied petroleum gases in the propulsion system of the vehicle shall be notified to the Type Approval Authority which approved the vehicle type. That Type Approval Authority may then either:

heading: Modification and extension of approval of a vehicle type
text: Consider that the modifications made are unlikely to have an appreciably adverse effect and that in any case the vehicle still complies with the requirements; or

heading: Modification and extension of approval of a vehicle type
text: Require a further test report from the Technical Service responsible for conducting the tests.

heading: Modification and extension of approval of a vehicle type
text: Confirmation or refusal of approval, specifying the alteration, shall be communicated by the procedure specified in paragraph 16.3. above to the Parties to the Agreement applying this Regulation.

heading: Modification and extension of approval of a vehicle type
text: The Type Approval Authority issuing the extension of approval shall assign a series number for such an extension and inform thereof the other Contracting Parties to the 1958 Agreement applying this Regulation by means of a communication form conforming to the model in Annex 2D to this Regulation.

Production definitively discontinued If the holder of the approval completely ceases to manufacture a type of vehicle approved in accordance with this Regulation, he shall so inform the Type Approval Authority which granted the approval.  Upon receiving the relevant communication, that Authority shall inform thereof the other Contracting Parties to the Agreement applying this Regulation by means of a communication form conforming to the model in Annex 2D to this Regulation.

Tr a nsitional provisions regarding the installation of various components of the LPG equipment and the type approval of a vehicle fitted with specific equipment for the use of liquefied petroleum gas in its propulsion system with regard to the installation of such equipment

heading: Modification and extension of approval of a vehicle type
text: As from the official date of entry into force of the 01 series of amendments to this Regulation, no Contracting Party applying this Regulation shall refuse to grant approval under this Regulation as amended by the 01 series of amendments.

heading: Modification and extension of approval of a vehicle type
text: As from the official date of entry into force of the 01 series of amendments to this Regulation, no Contracting Party applying this Regulation shall prohibit the fitting on a vehicle and the use as first equipment of a component approved under this Regulation as amended by the 01 series of amendments.

heading: Modification and extension of approval of a vehicle type
text: During the period of 12 months after the date of entry into force of the 01 series of amendments to this Regulation, Contracting Parties applying this Regulation may allow the use of as first equipment of a type of component approved to this Regulation in its original form, when fitted on a vehicle transformed for LPG propulsion.

heading: Modification and extension of approval of a vehicle type
text: Upon the expiration of a period of 12 months after the date of entry into force of the 01 series of amendments to this Regulation, Contracting Parties applying this Regulation shall prohibit the use as first equipment of a component which does not meet the requirements of this Regulation as amended by the 01 series of amendments, when fitted on a vehicle transformed for LPG propulsion.

heading: Modification and extension of approval of a vehicle type
text: Upon the expiration of a period of 12 months after the date of entry into force of the 01 series of amendments to this Regulation, Contracting Parties applying this Regulation may refuse first National Registration (first entry into service) of a vehicle which does not meet the requirements of this Regulation as amended by the 01 series of amendments.

heading: Modification and extension of approval of a vehicle type
text: As from the official date of entry into force of the 02 series of amendments, no Contracting Party applying this Regulation shall refuse to grant or refuse to accept type approvals under this Regulation as amended by the 02 series of amendments.

heading: Modification and extension of approval of a vehicle type
text: As from 1 September 2020, Contracting Parties applying this Regulation shall not be obliged to accept type approvals to the preceding series of amendments, first issued after 1 September 2020.

heading: Modification and extension of approval of a vehicle type
text: Until 1 September 2021, Contracting Parties applying this Regulation shall accept type approvals to the preceding series of amendments, first issued before 1 September 2020.

heading: Modification and extension of approval of a vehicle type
text: As from 1 September 2021, Contracting Parties applying this Regulation shall not be obliged to accept type approvals issued to the preceding series of amendments to this Regulation.

heading: Modification and extension of approval of a vehicle type
text: Notwithstanding paragraph 22.9., Contracting Parties applying the Regulation shall continue to accept type approvals of the equipment/parts issued according to the preceding series of amendments to the Regulation.

heading: Modification and extension of approval of a vehicle type
text: Notwithstanding paragraph 22.9., Contracting Parties applying this Regulation shall continue to accept type approvals issued according to the preceding series of amendments to this Regulation, for the vehicles/vehicle systems which are not affected by the changes introduced by the 02 series of amendments.

heading: Modification and extension of approval of a vehicle type
text: Contracting Parties applying this Regulation shall not refuse to grant type approvals according to any preceding series of amendments to this Regulation or extensions thereof.

heading: Modification and extension of approval of a vehicle type
text: As from 1 September 2021, Contracting Parties applying this Regulation may refuse national or regional type-approval and may refuse first registration of a vehicle type, if the vehicle type is affected by the changes introduced by the 02 series of amendments but does not meet the requirements of the 02 series of amendments to this Regulation.

heading: Modification and extension of approval of a vehicle type
text: As from the official date of entry into force of the 03 series of amendments, no Contracting Party applying this Regulation shall refuse to grant or refuse to accept type approvals under this Regulation as amended by the 03 series of amendments.

heading: Modification and extension of approval of a vehicle type
text: As from 1 September 2021, Contracting Parties applying this Regulation shall not be obliged to accept type approvals to the preceding series of amendments, first issued after 1 September 2021.

heading: Modification and extension of approval of a vehicle type
text: Until 1 September 2022, Contracting Parties applying this Regulation shall accept type approvals to the preceding series of amendments, first issued before 1 September 2021.

heading: Modification and extension of approval of a vehicle type
text: As from 1 September 2022, Contracting Parties applying this Regulation shall not be obliged to accept type approvals issued to the preceding series of amendments to this Regulation.

heading: Modification and extension of approval of a vehicle type
text: Notwithstanding paragraph 22.15. above, Contracting Parties applying the UN Regulation shall continue to accept UN type-approvals issued according to the preceding series of amendments to the UN Regulation, for the vehicles / vehicle systems / vehicle components which are not affected by the changes introduced by the 03 series of amendments.

heading: Modification and extension of approval of a vehicle type
text: As from the official date of entry into force of the 04 series of amendments, no Contracting Party applying this Regulation shall refuse to grant or refuse to accept type approvals under this Regulation as amended by the 03 series of amendments.

heading: Modification and extension of approval of a vehicle type
text: As from 1 September 2023, Contracting Parties applying this Regulation shall not be obliged to accept type approvals to the preceding series of amendments, first issued after 1 September 2023.

heading: Modification and extension of approval of a vehicle type
text: Until 1 September 2025, Contracting Parties applying this Regulation shall accept type approvals to the preceding series of amendments, first issued before 1 September 2023.

heading: Modification and extension of approval of a vehicle type
text: As from 1 September 2025, Contracting Parties applying this Regulation shall not be obliged to accept type approvals issued to the preceding series of amendments to this Regulation.

heading: Modification and extension of approval of a vehicle type
text: Notwithstanding paragraph 22.22. above, Contracting Parties applying the UN Regulation shall continue to accept UN type-approvals issued according to the preceding series of amendments to the UN Regulation, for the vehicles / vehicle systems / vehicle components which are not affected by the changes introduced by the 04 series of amendments.

Names and addresses of Technical Services responsible for conducting approval tests, and of Type Approval Authorities The Parties to the Agreement applying this Regulation shall communicate to the United Nations Secretariat the names and addresses of the Technical Services responsible for conducting approval tests and of the Type Approval Authorities which grant approval and to which forms certifying approval or extension or refusal or withdrawal of approval, issued in other countries, are to be sent.

heading: Annex 3 Provisions regarding the approval of LPG container accessories > Remotely controlled service valve with excess flow valve
text: If the remotely controlled service valve is closed during commanded stop phases, the valve shall be submitted to the following numbers of operations during the endurance test of paragraph 9. of Annex 16: (a) 200,000 cycles (mark "H1") if the engine shuts off automatically when the vehicle comes to a halt. (b) 500,000 cycles (mark "H2") if, in addition to (a), the engine also shuts off automatically when the vehicle drives with the electric motor only. (c) 1,000,000 cycles (mark "H3") if, in addition to (a) or (b), the engine also shuts off automatically when the accelerator pedal is released. Notwithstanding the above-mentioned provisions, the valve complying with (b) shall be deemed to satisfy (a), and the valve complying with (c) shall be deemed to satisfy (a) and (b).
